Table style

Source: R/table.R
table_style.Rd

`table_style()` defaults to a rules-only table: no fills, no vertical borders, light dividers between rows and a stronger rule under the header. `table_style_grid()` is the boxed look: filled header, borders around every cell, alternating row fills.

Usage

table_style(
  divider = line_style("rule_light", 0.75),
  header_rule = line_style("rule_strong", 0.75),
  last_divider = TRUE,
  pad_x = 0,
  pad_y = 9/96,
  header_pad_y = 7/96,
  col_gap = 12/96,
  valign = c("center", "top", "bottom"),
  header_valign = c("center", "top", "bottom"),
  fill = NA,
  alt_fill = NA,
  header_fill = NA,
  border = NULL,
  header_style = NULL,
  body_style = NULL
)

table_style_grid(...)

Arguments

divider

A [line_style()] drawn under each body row, or `NULL`.

header_rule

A [line_style()] under the header row, or `NULL`.

last_divider

Draw the divider under the last row too.

pad_x, pad_y

Cell padding (`grid::unit` or inches).

header_pad_y

Vertical padding of header cells.

col_gap

Space kept free at the right of every column but the last.

valign

Vertical alignment of body cells: `"center"`, `"top"` (for rows of long wrapped text) or `"bottom"`.

header_valign

Vertical alignment of header cells (`"bottom"` lines up wrapped header labels on the rule).

fill, alt_fill

Body row fills; `alt_fill` on even rows. `NA` for none.

header_fill

Header row fill.

border

A [line_style()] for the outer border and vertical lines between columns, or `NULL`.

header_style, body_style

Default text styles (or role names) for header and body cells; roles `table_header` and `table_body`.

...

For `table_style_grid()`, [table_style()] arguments that override the grid preset.

Value

A `bb_table_style` object.

Examples

table_style(divider = line_style("rule_faint"), valign = "top")
